gripOrHq.title: Sunburst Cranial Interface
gripOrHq.rulesText: Provides +1 MU and +1 hand size. Put [1] from the bank on Cranial Interface when it is installed. Use this bit only to pay for using icebreakers during runs, but not for using noisy icebreakers. If you use the bit, replace it from the bank at the start of your next turn. Only one deck can be in play at a time. Trash any older decks.

gripOrHq.title: Redecorator
gripOrHq.rulesText: [1]: Break up to two sentry subroutines on a single piece of ice. [3]: +1 strength

gripOrHq.title: Crumble
gripOrHq.rulesText: After each successful run on HQ, give the Corp a Crumble counter. Two or more Crumble counters allow you trash, at no cost, any cards accessed from HQ, even if the cards cannot normally be trashed. The Corp may remove all Virus counters at any time, but must then forgo its next three actions.

heapOrArchives.title: Viral Pipeline
heapOrArchives.rulesText: After each successful run on Archives, HQ, or R&D, put a Socket counter in that data fort. Socket counter from Archives, Socket counter from HQ, and Socket counter from R&D: Give the Corp a Pipe counter. Each Pipe counter causes the Corp to forgo an action at the start of each of its turns. The Corp may remove all Virus counters at any time, but must then forgo its next three actions.

heapOrArchives.title: Wrecking Ball
heapOrArchives.rulesText: [0]: Break wall subroutine. [2]: +1 strength. Whenever you break a wall subroutine with Wrecking Ball, lose [1] from a stealth card.

heapOrArchives.title: Disgruntled Ice Technician
heapOrArchives.rulesText: Make a run. After passing a piece of ice during this run, you may derez that ice and end your run if you broke all the subroutines of that ice.

heapOrArchives.title: Cortical Cybermodem
heapOrArchives.rulesText: Provides +2 MU and +2 hand size. Put [2] from the bank on Cortical Cybermodem when it is installed. Use these bits only to pay for using icebreakers during runs. If you use any of these bits, replace them from the bank at the start of your next turn. Only one deck can be in play at a time. Trash any older decks.

heapOrArchives.title: Bulldozer
heapOrArchives.rulesText: [1]: Break wall subroutine. [2]: +1 strength. If Bulldozer breaks all the subroutines of a wall, and the next piece of ice encountered during this run is a sentry, break one of the subroutines of that sentry, at no cost. Whenever you break a wall subroutine with Bulldozer, lose a total of [2] from stealth cards.

The Corp may remove all Virus counters at any time, but must then forgo its next three actions.

heapOrArchives.title: Fubar
heapOrArchives.rulesText: [1]: Break a subroutine of the type chosen for Fubar. [2]: +1 strength. [0]: Choose whether Fubar breaks code gates, sentries, or walls. Use this ability only once. Whenever you break an ice subroutine with Fubar, lose [1] from a stealth card.

heapOrArchives.title: Morphing Tool
heapOrArchives.rulesText: [2]: Break a subroutine of the type last chosen for Morphing Tool. [1]: +1 strength. [1], A: Choose whether Morphing Tool breaks code gates, sentries, or walls. When you install Morphing Tool, choose whether it breaks code gates, sentries, or walls.

heapOrArchives.title: Broker
heapOrArchives.rulesText: Each of your turns, you may take only one action to use Broker. A: Put [3] from the bank on Broker. A: Take all the bits from Broker.

scoreArea.title: Project Babylon
scoreArea.rulesText: Score 1 additional agenda point for every two advancement counters over Project Babylon's difficulty that are on Project Babylon when you score it.

rig.title: Highlighter
rig.rulesText: After each successful run on R&D, give the Corp a Highlighter counter. Each Highlighter counter after the first allows you to access an additional card from R&D whenever you access cards from R&D. The Corp may remove all Virus counters at any time, but must then forgo its next three actions.

rig.title: Big Frackin' Gun
rig.rulesText: [6]: Break up to five sentry subroutines on a single piece of ice. [1]: +1 strength

rig.title: Cortical Stimulators
rig.rulesText: Prevents 1 Net or brain damage each turn.

rig.title: Karl de Veres, Corporate Stooge
rig.rulesText: Gain [1] after each successful run. Only one unique card of a particular name can be in play at a time. If for some reason more than one is in play, trash all but one.

root.rulesText: Put [16] from the bank on BBS Whispering Campaign when you rez it.  When all the bits have been removed, trash BBS Whispering Campaign. A: Take [2] from BBS Whispering Campaign.
